title: Perioperative anxiety levels in patients receiving i.v. sedation with midazolam, nitrous oxide sedation and under local anesthesia
summary: Assessment of anxiety levels before and after oral surgery under local anesthesia and sedation.

interventions.name: local anestheaia, intra veinous, nitrous oxide

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
(1) Patients of the Department for Dental Surgery and Implantology
(2) Mastery of the German language
(3) Consent to participate in the study
(4) ASA - Class I and II
(5) Patient age >= 18 years
Exclusion criteria:
(1) No written consent to study
(2) ASA - Class III and IV
